about: How 'Add a market' (button 2) covers a whole market (agreed 22 Oct 2026; big partners only from 10 Nov 2026, Ariel: big wholesalers, distributors, importers and supermarket chains, not small retailers). Edit on GitHub with the pencil icon: keep the quotes and commas. What you type in button 2 is searched harder and first: each typed channel is split into the narrower searches below, gets a bigger search budget and a follow-up search when it fills all its places. Everything else is searched too, lighter and after: every country_channel across the whole country, then the country's main business cities and regional capitals (research lists them, one per region in a large country) with the city_channels only, so the strong regional distributors are found.
